desc: Derive the local gap transformation \((a,b,c)\mapsto(c,b,a)\) and identify parity-preserving gap swaps.
Prove all permutations within odd and even gap-index classes are reachable, and minimize via sorting each class nondecreasingly.
Implement an \(O(N\log N)\) stdin/stdout Python solution using the weighted gap formula and validate it on the samples.
Establish that integer input remains integer-safe and that the answer formula is \(N X_1+\sum_{j=1}^{N-1}(N-j)D_j\).
